name: delta-matrix
title: Delta matrix
description: Matrix of records against compared numeric fields with cells tinted by relative difference.
needs: At least one compared numeric field.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: One row per {unitOne}, one column per component. An empty cell agrees. A tinted cell shows the difference, in the colour of the side that is higher and stronger as the gap widens. Select a cell for both figures.

options.name: colourScale
options.description: Percent difference between sides that yields maximum colour saturation.
